run_dummy_plugin_main: run the dummy plugin main function to generate protobuf code generator responses from stdin
run_CodeGeneratorRequest_FromString: run CodeGeneratorRequest.FromString to parse a protobuf code generator request from binary input
create_CodeGeneratorResponse_File: create a CodeGeneratorResponse.File with a name, insertion point, and content string
run_CodeGeneratorResponse_SerializeToStr: run CodeGeneratorResponse.SerializeToString to serialize the response to binary output for stdout
test_main_function: test the main function by piping a CodeGeneratorRequest to stdin and reading the response from stdout
